{
  "name": "second-wind",
  "version": "0.1.2",
  "description": "A breath, an eye rest or a stretch while Claude works, sized to the wait.",
  "homepage": "https://modmyclaude.com/mods/second-wind",
  "repository": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods",
  "documentationUrl": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods/tree/main/mods/second-wind#readme",
  "supportUrl": "https://github.com/modmyclaude/claude-code-mods/issues",
  "privacyPolicyUrl": "https://modmyclaude.com/privacy",
  "termsOfServiceUrl": "https://modmyclaude.com/terms",
  "author": {
    "name": "modmyclaude"
  },
  "license": "MIT",
  "keywords": [
    "wellness",
    "breathing",
    "eye-rest",
    "stretch",
    "band",
    "spinner",
    "focus"
  ],
  "types": "./types/index.d.ts",
  "userConfig": {
    "enabled": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "On",
      "description": "Switch second-wind off without uninstalling it. The modmyclaude hub flips this too.",
      "default": true
    },
    "pattern": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Breathing pattern",
      "description": "What follows the opening physiological sigh: slow paced breathing (5.5 s in, 5.5 s out) or box breathing (4-4-4-4).",
      "default": "slow",
      "options": [
        "slow",
        "box"
      ]
    },
    "motion": {
      "type": "string",
      "title": "Motion",
      "description": "full animates the shape, gentle moves it less and less often, still shows the words only (for reduced motion).",
      "default": "full",
      "options": [
        "full",
        "gentle",
        "still"
      ]
    },
    "delaySeconds": {
      "type": "number",
      "title": "Delay (seconds)",
      "description": "How long a turn runs before the band appears. Quicker turns never show it. 0 to 600.",
      "default": 3
    },
    "eyeRest": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Eye rest",
      "description": "On turns over 60 seconds, offer a 20-20-20 eye rest between breaths.",
      "default": true
    },
    "stretch": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Stretch",
      "description": "On turns over 60 seconds, offer a one-line stretch between breaths.",
      "default": true
    },
    "movementCard": {
      "type": "boolean",
      "title": "Movement card",
      "description": "Every fifth long turn, offer a 'Stand up and stretch' or '10 squats' card with Did it and Skip buttons.",
      "default": false
    }
  }
}
